verdict.rationale: Terraform provides review gates for plan and apply. Apply prompts for approval of the plan, saved plan files (-out) let you apply exactly what was reviewed, and HCP Terraform policy enforcement (Sentinel/OPA) validates plans, with results viewable and overridable in the UI. The MCP server exposes workspace run management to agents. However, nothing in the evidence covers least-privilege or scoped credentials for an agent, and -auto-approve can bypass the interactive gate. missing for 10: documented least-privilege/scoped agent credentials, agent-specific approval workflow ensuring the agent cannot self-approve, independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an ai-native user, I can let an agent plan and apply with least-privilege credentials and review gates so it cannot make unapproved changes
